ACK-progress reset counts ANY inflight shrink (sender.rs:3083) including ACKs of FecParity/Duplicate packets, whereas TDD §4 RESET says 'new acked SOURCE data'. With FEC ON, parity ACKs can keep resetting the tail timer/backoff. Confirm intended.

validated_v1 max_ack_delay_ns=25 ms vs receiver behaviour: ACK_TICK=20 ms (runtime.rs:65) but the cold-start cadence floor is ≈8.4 s (receiver.rs:88-94); only the K_TAIL tail-SACK exemption (receiver.rs:282-291) makes tail ACKs timely, and it is inactive at sub-kbps (receiver.rs:98-99). Whether validated_v1's guard/PTO remain sound on sub-kbps paths was not verified in this audit (grid ran 200 ms/1 s RTT cells).

No product-visible tail telemetry in a default build: ClientStats carries none of tail_probe_diag*/due_edge; only sched[11] under feature diag-sched-telemetry (default OFF; CI builds --all-features). tx_retx_bytes mixes ARQ and tail probes. If v1 evidence requires proving tail activation from KP-CLIENT, decide whether to export tail_probe_diag_ext into ClientStats.

next_wakeup_ns / tail_probe_deadline_ns (source 5) has no product consumer (runtime.rs:6 D3 pump). If the 1 ms pump is the final product loop design, source 5 and the wakeup API are dead-in-product (currently pinned only by tests); otherwise the product loop should consume it. Ownership decision pending.

Tail recovery cannot be disabled from RuntimeConfig (no field; runtime.rs:181-210); the ON choice is hard-wired in ClientSession::new() (lib.rs:83). G2 explicitly chose construction-level flip; confirm that a product knob is intentionally absent for v1 (bench kama-product likewise cannot run tail-OFF, kama_product.rs:673-674).
Documentation staleness: reports/AI-HANDOFF-CURRENT.md:24 states the tail probe 'ships default-OFF'; product has shipped ON since G2 (2026-08-24, P3-DEFAULT-FLIP-DECISION.md:3-5). Not a code issue.

Double coverage of a tail unit in RecoverFwd: §11 pure-silence geometric copies (sender.rs:5495-5513) and the state-independent PTO probe (sender.rs:5434-5437) can both target the same oldest unit; no de-duplication and no measurement of the combined byte cost was found in this audit.
